buon.A: Same soft hand-painted storybook style, same round gold-rimmed medallion and same chibi proportions as the reference, but the person is now a young CONSORT (imperial concubine) of the inner palace, a graceful woman about twenty-two with a soft pretty face, black hair in a neat elegant bun with two gold hairpins, a small pearl hair ornament and one small pink flower (no crown, no phoenix), a jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with an ivory (#F1E6D2) collar and light gold embroidery at the shoulders. The medallion disc is now light blue instead of red. Her face and pose: crying face, eyes squeezed shut, tears running down both cheeks, one hand dabbing her eyes with a white handkerchief, a tiny pale-blue raincloud. Clear readable action: the handkerchief dabbing her eyes clearly visible, the other hand resting at the bottom of the medallion just inside the gold rim, exactly two hands. Both eyes looking together. Everything kept INSIDE the round medallion, the medallion drawn a bit smaller and centred so there is empty space around it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background outside the medallion, nothing else, no text.
buon.B: Same young consort, same soft hand-painted storybook style, same elegant black bun with two gold hairpins, small pearl ornament and small pink flower, same jade green (#6FAE92) silk robe with ivory (#F1E6D2) collar, same round gold-rimmed light blue medallion as the reference. NEW: she is CRYING and leans OUT of the round medallion toward the viewer: her head and shoulders come forward over the gold rim, her hands overlap the gold ring; a clear readable action, no big arms, arms stay inside the picture, exactly two hands, no extra hands; one hand dabbing her eyes with a white handkerchief, the other hand clutching the gold rim; eyes squeezed shut, mouth trembling, tears running down both cheeks; a tiny pale-blue raincloud above her head. Wide jade green sleeves visible. Both eyes looking together. The medallion stays round and centred, a bit smaller, with her popping slightly out of it. Bare earlobes, no earrings. Whole picture on a flat pure chroma green (#00FF00) background, nothing else, no text.
buon.out: Hand-painted storybook animation, static camera, flat chroma green background stays perfectly flat green the whole time. The young consort with the gold hairpins inside the round gold medallion starts to cry: she leans forward over the gold rim, squeezes her eyes shut, tears run down her cheeks and she dabs her eyes with a white handkerchief, a tiny raincloud appears; she comes out of the round frame toward the viewer. Clear readable action, exactly two hands, arms stay inside the picture, the medallion keeps exactly its same size and colour. Smooth, cartoon-like, same painted style, no camera move, no new objects.
